# Vectorization summary (generated by scripts/vecreport.py)

VF = vectorization width (lanes), IC = interleave count. Elements per main-loop iteration = VF x IC. Loop columns count instructions in the largest vector loop body of the object (the main loop). `fmla.v` = vector fused multiply-add (fmla .4s/.2d), `fmadd.s` = scalar fused multiply-add, `ldp/ldr q` and `stp/str q` = 128-bit vector memory ops. 'remark' is the loop-vectorize passed/missed text.
